name: KAMA Holdings Limited
summary: KAMA Holdings Limited engages in technical textiles, chemicals and polymers, aluminum foils, and packaging film businesses. The company operates through Technical Textiles Business, Chemicals Business, Performance Films & Foil Business, and Others segments. It offers nylon tyre cord, belting, coated, laminated, and polyester tyre cord fabrics and industrial yarns. The company also provides refrigerant gases, industrial and specialty chemicals, fluorochemicals, packaging films, and related products; and manufactures aluminium films, and BOPP and metallized BOPP films.
